description: Ministry of Telecommunication Foreign Affairs and Sports - Appointed Mr. N. A. Weerasinghe as President Mr. H. A. W. Abayakumara
reasoning: This gazette notification contains regulations made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, specifically exercising powers granted by Sections 32 and 33 of that Act. It involves the extension of a suspension period and the appointment of an interim committee, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes (no detailed ministerial portfolios described) or organizational structure changes.
